description: Knowledge base for Step-Declarations of the Water Licence Application. Covers important legal notices applicants must review before submission and the declaration statement.

knowledge_items.title: Submitting Does Not Authorize Water Use
keywords: submitting application does not authorize water use
no water use before licence granted
knowledge_items.content: Submitting a water licence application does not authorize diversion, use, or storage of water except for limited testing purposes under Section 6(2)(b) of the Water Sustainability Act.

knowledge_items.title: No Authorization for Groundwater Construction Use
knowledge_items.content: Submitting an application does not authorize use of water from wells or groundwater sources for construction purposes.

knowledge_items.title: Review and Decision Required Before Licence Is Granted
knowledge_items.content: The application must be reviewed and a decision must be made before any water licence is granted. Additional information may be requested during the review process.

knowledge_items.title: Federal Fisheries Act May Apply
knowledge_items.content: Applications may be subject to federal Fisheries Act requirements.

knowledge_items.title: Application Locked After Proceeding
knowledge_items.content: Once the user clicks 'Next', the application will be locked and cannot be edited.

knowledge_items.title: Applicant Declaration Statement
knowledge_items.content: The applicant declares that the information contained in the form is complete and accurate. The user must explicitly confirm this before submission.
